semantic_profiles.V: Dynamic non-text visual evidence changes answerability.
semantic_profiles.A: A concrete localizable source-world non-speech event changes answerability.
semantic_profiles.V+S: Vision and speech each carry a non-duplicative necessary answer component after route closure.
semantic_profiles.V+S+A: Vision, substantive speech, and concrete non-speech audio each carry a non-duplicative necessary answer component after route closure.

far_requires: every component needed for one composed answer

acquisition_cost_bands.LOW: Exact local media and full index already present; no transfer required.

acquisition_cost_bands.HIGH: Gate or agreement, duration/audio, privacy, or multiview decisions unresolved.

execution_waves.name: Current exact-source semantic prescreen
execution_waves.go: At least two defensible V+S prospects survive, or one V+S plus two coherent far prospects survive, under unchanged semantic and rights rules.
execution_waves.repair: Useful source facts exist but rights, recurrence, component lineage, or substitution fields remain open.
execution_waves.no_go: All speech-vision pairs are duplicate routes and all far pairs are arbitrary or distance-only.

execution_waves.name: Selective exact research-dataset acquisition
execution_waves.go: The combined pool contains at least two source-disjoint V+S, two source-disjoint V+S+A, and six far/multi prospects before author/verifier acceptance.
execution_waves.repair: One triple-modal or two far cells remain open and a distinct rights-ready route is concretely identified.
execution_waves.no_go: Required cells remain empty across three or more lineages, or only correlated EPIC-family sources can fill them.

execution_waves.name: High-cost independent-lineage or public-asset repair
execution_waves.go: Exact route-specific rights, audio, duration, timestamp, and semantic gates close and the route adds a missing source-disjoint stratum.
execution_waves.repair: The route remains scientifically plausible but one bounded technical or governance field remains open.
execution_waves.no_go: The route requires weaker rights, source grouping, modality, temporal, or blindness rules, or exceeds the acquisition-cost stop rule.

prospective_narrowing_rules.trigger: Fewer than two source-disjoint triple-modal candidates survive after at least 12 rights-eligible audio-verified long-source prescreens across at least four lineages, including at least six initially plausible triple-modal intervals.
prospective_narrowing_rules.action: Remove V+S+A from the pilot denominator and paper claims before scientific execution; report negative feasibility evidence.
prospective_narrowing_rules.forbidden_action: Relabel V+A, S+A, co-occurrence, score, or duplicate routes as V+S+A.

prospective_narrowing_rules.trigger: Fewer than five new coherent far replacements survive after complete review of the current exact pool, at least four new source-disjoint long groups, and at least 20 far-composition attempts.
prospective_narrowing_rules.action: Replace the exact 6/6 far balance with descriptive far/multi feasibility reporting in a prospectively versioned narrower pilot.
prospective_narrowing_rules.forbidden_action: Pair unrelated intervals or use temporal distance alone.

prospective_narrowing_rules.trigger: Fewer than two candidates survive speech-only, vision-only, OCR/caption/transcript, repeat-clip, and question-prior challenges.
prospective_narrowing_rules.action: Narrow claims to corroborative audiovisual routing or source navigation rather than V+S necessity.
prospective_narrowing_rules.forbidden_action: Count duplicate spoken and visible text as two necessary modalities.

prospective_narrowing_rules.trigger: Any required cell is fillable only by weakening rights, source-disjointness, semantic-prescreen, minimality, temporal-coherence, or blindness rules.
prospective_narrowing_rules.action: Set Gate A to NO_GO for the broad matrix and preregister a narrower pilot.
prospective_narrowing_rules.forbidden_action: Preserve quotas through relabeling or fabricated evidence.

global_stop_rules: Stop broad V+S+A prospecting after 12 long source groups across four lineages complete semantic prescreen without two triple-modal survivors.
Stop exact far-balance prospecting after 20 far-composition attempts across at least ten source groups yield fewer than five coherent far families.
Stop a route when estimated acquisition, indexing, governance, and prescreen labor exceeds 40 hours per surviving candidate.
Stop immediately if a route requires semantic labels for source or interval outcome selection.
Stop immediately if exact rights, annotation authority, source grouping, native audio, or stable timestamps cannot be established without assumption.
final_boundary_statement: This plan ranks evidence requirements and acquisition routes only. It does not claim human listening, semantic validation, access, rights, accepted SESs, H tiers, Gate-A GO, scientific execution, or release.
